description: Design choices for trace.nacka.v1 (scripts/nacka-trace.py). There is no video of Näcka: the evidence is the NTHF description and movement illustration (references/combinations/puck-no-nacka.html, trick-nacka.png). The set-up and the physical rates are borrowed from the measured spjass (same set-up per NTHF: 'Center starts with the puck in the heel groove'). Every value is either taken from those sources (cited) or an assumption named as such.
source_text: Center starts with the puck in the heel groove, passes with the heel a few centimeters out to the right, and shoots with the blade into the right corner

illustration_readings.scale_from: goal mouth 104 px = preview mouth 86.94 mm
illustration_readings.note: schematic drawing (not to scale, perspective-free): used for the pass length and direction and the target corner only

borrowed_from_spjass.rest: W-C rest pose and resting puck of trace.spjass.v1 (heading 180.2 deg, puck touching the heel)

goalie.note: ASSUMED: E-G on its slot 9.5 mm toward its own right (+y) from the assembly pose, covering the left post (where the spjass goes from the same set-up); with the assembly pose its stick closes the right corner for any straight shot.

heel_pass.note: ASSUMED timing: clockwise turn of about 37 deg in 75 ms; the back of the right skate (heel) pushes the puck out to the right. Length chosen for a pass of about 4 cm (NTHF: 'a few centimeters'); its direction follows from the model skate (about -44 deg; the illustration shows about -69 deg).

shot.note: ASSUMED: W-C steps 43 mm up its slot and turns back counter-clockwise; the blade comes square behind the puck and drives it into the right corner (chosen from a scan of the lunge length and the heading at contact: cleanest goal, blade and net the only contacts).
